name: Lynn Linmei
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c12570]Taisuke[/url] and [url=http://vndb.org/c12577]Ryuu's[/url] teacher. She gives Taisuke a hard time making sure he does well in school. In addition to teaching she works part time at a Chinese restaurant.

[spoiler] In the extended side story she gives birth to Taisuke's daughter and becomes pregnant again with his second child. [/spoiler]
